title: Animals (Interfaces)
hints: interface Animal { String name(); String sound(); }
Methods that implement an interface must be public: public String sound() { return "Woof"; }
An Animal[] array can hold a Dog, a Cat… anything that implements Animal.

mustContain.message: Your animal classes should implement Animal.
Store the animals in an Animal[] array.
